Stazione Centrale — Milan, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The area immediately around Milano Centrale railway station. This is one of the more genuinely documented problem areas in Milan: it has been under an official municipal 'zona rossa' (red zone, allowing police to issue exclusion orders) since December 2024, extended through the 2026 Winter Olympics, and a security summit reported recorded crime up 5% over five months, alongside ongoing issues with encampments, drug dealing and street-level degrado described repeatedly in local press. It's still a functioning, heavily-trafficked transport hub used safely by huge numbers of people daily — but of the areas on this map, it has the clearest, most consistently reported case for extra caution, especially at night.
